expected_verdict_reason: The captured A52s reports no partition layout property, so its identity is not fully confirmed and the verifier cannot say not-ready. It lists the locked bootloader as unmet. An A52s that reports its layout would return not-ready while locked.

android_version.source_evidence: LineageOS a52sxq requires Android 13 or 14 stock firmware

bootloader_state.source_evidence: OEM unlock toggle in Developer options, then the unlock choice in download mode; wipes userdata. The phone reports the result in ro.boot.flash.locked (the captured SM-A528B reports 1, locked)

verdict_gap_reason: An SM-A528B on Android 13 or 14 stock firmware, bootloader unlocked through download mode, satisfies every precondition the LineageOS page states before vbmeta and recovery are written.
